name: studio-helper
description: Studio helper: passes the Studio's setup requests to Cloudflare, Resend, Stripe and Supabase, which don't accept calls from web pages. Stores nothing but the hashed keys of the Studios connected to it.

HELPER.description: Holds the hashed keys of the Studios connected to this helper. Created for you.

STUDIO_URL.description: Your Studio's address. Leave it as it is unless your Studio runs somewhere else.
